name: make-pixel-splats
description: Make pixel art scenes from gaussian splats written by code, with no 3D model, rendered in Crucible: shapes from signed distance functions, light baked into each splat, then glow, haze, a small palette and dither, or the crisp ink look with body-coloured contours. Ships example scenes, motion helpers, a headless frame renderer, film plans and a 'how it's made' explainer compositor. Use for pixel art splats, voxel splat dioramas, code-built gaussian splat scenes, "làm pixel art bằng splat", "dựng cảnh splat bằng code", "splat art như trên X", "video cách làm splat".
